operating_notes.text: Commissioned 4 facilities across Kolkata, Krishnapatnam, Kundli, and Jaipur, adding ~17,000 pallet positions.
West Asia conflict has negatively impacted import and export freight volumes.
Company spent ₹43.98 Cr on Krishnapatnam project where registration of 5.24 acres land and warehouse remains rejected by authorities, backed by promoter indemnity.
Capacity utilisation stood at 85% for Q2FY27.
Total pallet capacity reached 1,51,618 across 40 warehouses in 21 cities.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹142.31 Cr, net profit ₹5.54 Cr.
Snowman Logistics reported FY26 revenue of ₹604.4 Cr, up 9.4% YoY, with an EBITDA of ₹94.5 Cr.
Snowman Logistics Limited shared the conference call recording for audited financial results (Q4FY26 & FY26) held on May 7, 2026, via the provided link.
Snowman Logistics and Gateway Distriparks held their Q4 FY26 earnings conference call discussing volume headwinds and expansion plans.
Gateway Distriparks Limited, as Promoter of Snowman Logistics Limited, declared no encumbrance on its 50.01% stake during FY2025-26 under SEBI’s Reg. 31(4).
Q2FY27 results (standalone): revenue ₹163.56 Cr (+5.1% YoY), net profit ₹0.96 Cr (against a loss of ₹2.91 Cr a year earlier).
Snowman Logistics reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹163.6 Cr and a turnaround to a PAT of ₹1.0 Cr.
Link to audio recording of earnings call held on 28 October 2026 for unaudited financial results of quarter ended 30 September 2026.
Snowman Logistics received an Income Tax rectification order reducing its AY 2024-25 penalty demand by ₹34.4 lakh to ₹1.72 Cr, which remains under appeal.

watchlist.response: Headcount is scaling up for domestic operations and Ankleshwar, alongside retention scheme bonuses.
watchlist.text: Employee costs rose significantly by 12-13% YoY in FY26.
